_comment: Websites the agent may open. 'aliases' are other names the user might say. GHOST MODE: steps marked foreground_only are skipped, and steps marked ghost_only are used, when an action can run silently (no mouse/keyboard) - see GHOST_MODE in agent/config.py. TIP for login forms: never CLICK the password box after typing the username - the browser's saved-login dropdown covers it. Press escape then tab instead. 'window_title' + 'actions' let the agent click and type inside the page (same format as apps.json; run python inspect_window.py followed by part of the window title, with the page open, to get exact control names). 'search_url' is optional: if present the agent can search that site directly ({query} is replaced with the search text). The agent never logs in for you - sign in once in your browser and it stays signed in.

websites.name: IITD Webmail
websites.description: IIT Delhi college email (the user must already be signed in)

autofill_login.description: used by sign_in only: lets Edge fill its own saved login, then submits

login.description: used by sign_in only - do not call directly

compose.description: writes a draft, does NOT send. fields: to, subject, body

send.description: sends the draft that is currently open

open_inbox.description: go to the mail list; then use read_page to see the messages

search_mail.description: text = words to search for in the mailbox (sender, subject...); then read_page

open_message.description: text = part of the subject of a message in the list; opens it; then read_page

reply.description: start a reply to the open message (then write_reply)

write_reply.description: text = your reply, typed above the quoted original; does NOT send

websites.name: IITD OCS
websites.description: IIT Delhi student application portal (login has a CAPTCHA the user must solve)
websites.login_note: Entered the saved username and password on the OCS login page. It has a CAPTCHA: ask the user to solve it and press Login themselves.

autofill_login.description: used by sign_in only: opens the login page and lets Edge fill its saved login; stops before the CAPTCHA

login.description: used by sign_in only - do not call directly; stops before the CAPTCHA
